source_selection: building or building:part tag exists and value is not no
caveats: No inferred heights, floors, addresses, use, occupancy or damage.
Point hints, areas and parts are separate groups; do not sum them as unique buildings.
not_assembled includes open ways and incomplete/unsupported relations; source records retained.
Grid uses bbox midpoint for storage only, not an administrative assignment.
No cross-source or relation/member-way deduplication inferred.
Nonempty tag coverage is not accuracy or numeric validity.
Source date label supplied by caller; PBF metadata may be absent.
Only objects present in input; no claim of complete national coverage.
storage: Lossless gzip SQLite shards; materialize to .cache before querying. Do not attach compressed files directly.
